text:
ryan: Hey team — sales asked if we can commit p95=120ms, p99=350ms for FinEdge (QPS 1200, avg seq 256). Seen similar ask before. Can we make a recommendation?

maria: Quick summary: current prod profile (microbatch=2, KV warm) hits p95=95ms, p99=420ms at that QPS on m40x2. p99 tail dominated by cold KV misses + kernel tail under long sequences.

devin: Profiling: attached flame shows ~60% time in attention kernels at seq>384; the kernel selection we rolled last week (fused_attn_v2) has higher variance. Repro snippet:

```
perf_snippet:
  model: llama-13b
  microbatch: 2
  seq_len: 512
  kernel: fused_attn_v2
  p50/p95/p99: 40/120/430
```

sales_kara: Customer will accept 250ms p99 if p95 stays <=120ms and we provide rollback plan. Is 250ms realistic?

maria: 250ms p99 is tight given current kernel variance. Options:
- reduce microbatch -> microbatch=1 lowers queuing jitter but raises GPU utilization (cost + less throughput)
- enable KV prewarm for this customer (warm hits drop p99 by ~100ms)
- fall back to quantized kernel variant (lower throughput but more stable tail)

ryan: What's microbatch=1 tradeoff? throughput capacity drop?

devin: Microbatch=1 reduces batching latency; our bench shows throughput per-GPU drops ~18-22% for long sequences. At QPS 1200 we'd need ~1.25x GPUs. Also kernel swapping cost: switching between fused_attn_v2 and stable_attn adds ~8ms on first request after cold swap.

eng-runtime-bot: perf-regression-alert: fused_attn_v2 rollout 2026-02-18 increased p99 variance on long-tail by +12% in canary.

prod_ellen: If we promise 250ms p99 we need fallback automated policy: if p99>250ms for 5m, switch to quantized-stable model and notify sales. Also add KV prewarm for high-priority customers.

maria: Proposed config to try next week for FinEdge (canary 10%):
- microbatch: 1
- kv_warm_policy: prewarm_on_route (1000 prefixes)
- kernel_order: [stable_attn, fused_attn_v2] (prefer stable on tail)
- autoscale: +20% headroom

devin: I'll run a perf run with microbatch=1 + KV prewarm and send numbers. Short note: don’t forget to test cold pod start (pod spinup) — that can add ~150ms if KV load is lazy.

sales_kara: That's good. Can we promise rollback window and a runbook snippet for the customer?

ryan: I'll draft the SLO proposal: p95<=120ms, p99<=250ms (with policy: if p99 > 250ms for >5m auto-fallback and notify). Devin + Maria, add bench results by EOD Wednesday and I'll share with Sales/Customer.

devin: On it. Sending initial bench in ~24h. Expect microbatch=1 p95~85ms p99~260-300ms (without KV prewarm). With prewarm should hit ~230-250ms.

maria: also leaving note: if we accept p99=250ms we should attach cost uplift estimate (~+20% infra). Sales: need sign-off on budget.

sales_kara: I'll push budget ask to customer now. :thumbsup:
